name: svg_vector_embed
summary: The 5th MoE retrieval axis — explicit geometric vector embedding via SVG path parsing. 64-dim DCT-II shape descriptor per path, translation + scale invariant (centered + unit-bbox normalized + arc-length resampled). Same DCT pipeline as wave_embedding but on numerical (x,y) coordinate sequences instead of byte streams. Crystal-anchored so every path ties back to a deterministic source.
engine_pattern: pure-Python SVG path parser → coordinate sequence → normalize → arc-length resample → DCT-II → L2-normalize. Stdlib only (re, math, xml.etree). No svglib, no cairosvg, no inkscape required.

inbound_callers: core/scripts/svg_harvest.sh (walks any root for *.svg → emits ParserCursor JSONL)
PinterestConnector.harvest_curated (when pin's source_url points at SVG content)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: SVG files (any path passed by caller)

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.scale_invariant_match: two same-shape circles different sizes → cosine 1.0
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.self_recall_on_corpus: querying MASTER-TODO.svg path returns itself at sim 1.0
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.geometric_neighbor: long horizontal arrow → TWINS-MASTER similar shape sim 0.98
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.negative_match: long arrow vs small triangle → sim 0.17 (correctly rejected)

limits_v0: Rotation NOT normalized (would need PCA over point cloud — defer)
Bezier curves use endpoint approximation (curvature signature lost — adequate for shape matching)
Very short paths (2-3 points) collapse to similar embeddings after resampling
guarantees: Deterministic — same path string → same 64-d embedding byte-exact
Pure-Python stdlib — no SVG library dependencies
Sub-50ms per typical path (most SVG paths have < 200 waypoints)
the_pin_motherload_thesis: Pinterest has a treasure trove of vector graphics referenced via pin source_urls. PinterestConnector.harvest_curated with categories ['svg','vector_illustration','icon_set','logo_design','infographic'] surfaces pins; those linking to github raw .svg / codepen / figma get fetched + embedded here. Every harvested path becomes a crystal-anchored node joinable across all 5 MoE retrieval axes.
usage_example: from svg_vector_embed import svg_path_embedding, find_svg_neighbors\nemb = svg_path_embedding('M50,50 C50,77.6 27.6,100 0,100 ...')\nprint(len(emb))  # 64
